sehemu: Part VI: Execution of Court Orders
jina: Execution of court orders throughout Tanzania
maudhui: (1) Documents containing orders issued by courts of Mainland Tanzania and courts of Tanzania Zanzibar in all civil and criminal proceedings, including warrants of arrest, may be transmitted to any place in Tanzania and the orders may be executed anywhere in Tanzania subject to the following: (a) where a court issues a document containing an order to be executed in a place where that court has no jurisdiction, the document shall be transmitted there and the order shall be executed according to the procedure applicable in that place; and (b) where the law applicable in the place to which the document is transmitted requires documents issued by a court elsewhere to be authenticated by a court having jurisdiction there, such document shall first be authenticated. (2) Where a person is arrested anywhere in Tanzania under a warrant issued by a court having no jurisdiction in the place of arrest, that person shall be deemed to be in lawful custody and may be brought before the court which issued the warrant. (3) Nothing in this Article shall prevent a law from prescribing a procedure for transmitting outside Tanzania documents issued by courts of Mainland Tanzania or courts of Tanzania Zanzibar.
